description: The retrieval and answer evaluation set of RepoMemo. Each case builds a small workspace from `docs`, asks `query`, and states what must and must not be found. It needs no AI provider: it checks the evidence Ask would be given and the rules Ask is given. Changing a case or adding one raises the version.
